Writing An embarrassing moment
A Think ofanembarrassingmoment that happenedtoyouorsomeoneyouknow
Answer the questions.
When did it happen?
Who was there?
Where did it happen?
@ Where did it happen? ___ @ Why was it embarrassing?
B Write a description of an embarrassing moment that happened to you or someone
you know. Use the model and your answers in Part A to help you.
Embarrassed at the Supermarket
When | was about six years old, | was at the supermarket with
my mom. She was shopping for groceries. | wanted some candy,
but my mom didn’t want to buy me any. So, when my mother
wasn't looking, | took some candy and put it into the cart. The
problem was that | put the candy into the wrong cart...
CLASS ACTIVITY Post your papers around the classroom.Then read the stories
and rate them from 1 (very embarrassing) to 4 (not embarrassing at all). Which
stories are the most embarrassing?
